  let i3 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i2 c1)
  let i4 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i3 d1)

  let i6 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i5)

  let i11 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i10 d1)
  let i12 ← i11 % p
  let i13 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i12)
  let i14 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add a1 b1)
  let i15 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_mul 2#u64 c1)
  let i16 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i14 i15)
  let i17 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_mul 3#u64 d1)

  let i19 ← i18 % p
  let i20 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i19)

      aspis_r0_poseidon_copy.internal_round state i1
        aspis_r0_poseidon_copy.INTERNAL_SHIFTS

      let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub round 18#usize)
      let a ← Array.index_usize aspis_r0_poseidon_copy.EXTERNAL_FINAL i
      aspis_r0_poseidon_copy.full_round state a

def aspis_r0_writer_copies.merge_check_loop
  (stable : Array Std.U32 16384#usize) (late : Array Std.U32 16384#usize)
  (ok1 : Bool) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let i1 ← aspis_r0_writer_copies.TRACE_CELLS
  if i < i1
  then
    let row ← i % 1024#usize
    let ok2 ←
      if row >= 544#usize
      then
        if row < 864#usize
        then
          do
          let i2 ← Array.index_usize stable i
          if i2 != 0#u32
          then ok false
          else ok ok1
        else
          do
          let i2 ← Array.index_usize late i
          if i2 != 0#u32
          then ok false
          else ok ok1
      else
        do
        let i2 ← Array.index_usize late i
        if i2 != 0#u32
        then ok false
        else ok ok1

  else ok ok1

def poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_threaded
  {F : Type} (coreopsfunctionFnMutFTuplePoseidon2RoundTransitionTupleInst :
  core.ops.function.FnMut F poseidon2.Poseidon2RoundTransition Unit)
  (state : Array aspis_core.field.M31 16#usize) (trace : F) :
  Result ((Array aspis_core.field.M31 16#usize) × F)
  := do
  let state1 ← poseidon2.external_linear_lazy state
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice poseidon2.EXTERNAL_INITIAL)
  let i ← core.slice.Slice.iter s
  let iter ←
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.trait_default
      (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter (Array Std.U32 16#usize)) i
  let (state2, trace1, round, input) ←
    poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop0
      coreopsfunctionFnMutFTuplePoseidon2RoundTransitionTupleInst iter state1
      trace 0#u8 state
  let ii ←
    Array.Insts.CoreIterTraitsCollectIntoIteratorTIntoIter.into_iter
      poseidon2.INTERNAL
  let iter1 ←
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.trait_default
      (core.array.iter.IntoIter.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator Std.U32
      14#usize) ii
  let (state3, trace2, round1, input1) ←
    poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop1
      coreopsfunctionFnMutFTuplePoseidon2RoundTransitionTupleInst iter1 state2
      trace1 round input
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice poseidon2.EXTERNAL_FINAL)
  let i1 ← core.slice.Slice.iter s1
  let iter2 ←
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.trait_default
      (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter (Array Std.U32 16#usize)) i1
  poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop2
    coreopsfunctionFnMutFTuplePoseidon2RoundTransitionTupleInst iter2 state3
    trace2 round1 input1

def poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace
  {F : Type} (callback : core.ops.function.FnMut F poseidon2.Poseidon2RoundTransition Unit)
  (state : Array aspis_core.field.M31 16#usize) (trace : F) :
  Result (Array aspis_core.field.M31 16#usize) := do
  let (next, _) ← poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_threaded callback state trace
  ok next

  (w : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RW)
  (p : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RP) (n : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U32 8#usize)

  then pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.out_pair_r w p

def poseidon2.merkle_node_compress_v3
  (left : Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize)
  (right : Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) :
  Result (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize)
  := do
  let state := Array.repeat 16#usize aspis_core.field.M31.ZERO
  let (s, index_mut_back) ←
    core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice aspis_core.field.M31))
      state { «end» := poseidon2.DIGEST_ELEMS }
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice left)
  let s2 ←
    core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreMarkerCopy
      s s1
  let state1 := index_mut_back s2
  let (s3, index_mut_back1) ←
    core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice aspis_core.field.M31))
      state1 { start := poseidon2.DIGEST_ELEMS }
  let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice right)
  let s5 ←
    core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreMarkerCopy
      s3 s4
  let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH 1#usize)
  let state2 := index_mut_back1 s5
  let m ← Array.index_usize state2 i
  let m1 ←
    aspis_core.field.M31.add m poseidon2.MERKLE_NODE_COMPRESSION_V3_TWEAK
  let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH 1#usize)
  let state3 ← Array.update state2 i1 m1
  let state4 ←
    poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace
      poseidon2.merkle_node_compress_v3.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTuplePoseidon2RoundTransitionTuple
      state3 ()
  core.array.from_fn 8#usize
    poseidon2.merkle_node_compress_v3.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeM31
    state4

/-- [aspis_statement::pool_v1::format::pool_v1_tree_parent]:

def pool_v1.format.pool_v1_tree_parent
  (left : Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize)
  (right : Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) :
  Result (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize)
  := do
  poseidon2.merkle_node_compress_v3 left right

/-- [aspis_statement::pool_v1::incremental_merkle::{aspis_statement::pool_v1::incremental_merkle::IncrementalMerkleTreeV1}::reconstruct_nonfull_root_from_level]: loop 0:

@[rust_loop]
def
  pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.reconstruct_nonfull_root_from_level_loop
  (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) (i : Std.U64)
  (a : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 20#usize)
  (empty : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 21#usize)
  (node : Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) :
  Result (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize)
  := do
  let (o, iter1) ←
    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter
  match o with
  | none => ok node
  | some level =>
    let i1 ← lift (R1Z.BuilderStdModels.shift64 i level)
    let i2 ← lift (i1 &&& 1#u64)
    if i2 = 0#u64
    then
      let a1 ← Array.index_usize empty level
      let node1 ← pool_v1.format.pool_v1_tree_parent node a1
      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.reconstruct_nonfull_root_from_level_loop
        iter1 i a empty node1
    else
      let a1 ← Array.index_usize a level
      let node1 ← pool_v1.format.pool_v1_tree_parent a1 node
      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.reconstruct_nonfull_root_from_level_loop
        iter1 i a empty node1
partial_fixpoint

def
  pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.reconstruct_nonfull_root_from_level
  (self : pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1)
  (empty : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 21#usize)
  (start_level : Std.Usize) :
  Result (core.result.Result (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize)
    pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError)
  := do
  let i ← pool_v1.incremental_merkle.POOL_V1_LEAF_CAPACITY
  if self.next_leaf_index >= i
  then
    ok (core.result.Result.Err
      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError.TreeFull)
  else
    if start_level > pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH
    then
      ok (core.result.Result.Err
        pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError.IndexOutOfRange)
    else
      let node ← Array.index_usize empty start_level
      let node1 ←
        pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.reconstruct_nonfull_root_from_level_loop
          { start := start_level, «end» := pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH
          } self.next_leaf_index self.frontier empty node
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok node1)

/-- [aspis_statement::pool_v1::incremental_merkle::tree_reference::validate_owned]: loop 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-statement/src/pool_v1/../../../../tools/r1-builder-reference/tree.rs', lines 154:4-159:5
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop]
def pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.validate_owned_loop
  (i : Std.U64) (a : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 20#usize)
  (empty : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 21#usize)
  (result : core.result.Result Unit pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError)
  (level : Std.Usize) :
  Result (core.result.Result Unit pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError)
  := do
  if level < pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH
  then
    let b ← core.result.Result.is_ok result
    if b
    then
      let i1 ← lift (R1Z.BuilderStdModels.shift64 i level)
      let i2 ← lift (i1 &&& 1#u64)
      let result1 ←
        if i2 = 0#u64
        then
          do
          let a1 ← Array.index_usize a level
          let a2 ← Array.index_usize empty level
          let b1 ←
            core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.ne
              aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31 a1 a2
          if b1
          then
            ok (core.result.Result.Err
              pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError.NonCanonicalFrontier)
          else ok result
        else ok result
      let level1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add level 1#usize)
      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.validate_owned_loop i a empty
        result1 level1
    else ok result
  else ok result
partial_fixpoint

/-- [aspis_statement::pool_v1::incremental_merkle::tree_reference::validate_owned]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-statement/src/pool_v1/../../../../tools/r1-builder-reference/tree.rs', lines 147:0-173:1
    Visibility: public -/
def pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.validate_owned
  (tree : pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1)
  (empty : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 21#usize) :
  Result (core.result.Result Unit pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError)
  := do
  let i ← pool_v1.incremental_merkle.POOL_V1_LEAF_CAPACITY
  if tree.next_leaf_index > i
  then
    ok (core.result.Result.Err
      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError.IndexOutOfRange)
  else
    let result ←
      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.validate_owned_loop
        tree.next_leaf_index tree.frontier empty (core.result.Result.Ok ())
        0#usize
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch result
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
      if tree.next_leaf_index = 0#u64
      then
        let a ← Array.index_usize empty pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH
        let b ←
          core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq
            aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31 tree.root a
        if b
        then ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())
        else
          ok (core.result.Result.Err
            pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError.RootMismatch)
      else
        if tree.next_leaf_index < i
        then
          let r ←
            pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.reconstruct_nonfull_root
              tree empty
          let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
          match cf1 with
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
            let b ←
              core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.ne
                aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31 val tree.root
            if b
            then
              ok (core.result.Result.Err
                pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError.RootMismatch)
            else ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
              Unit (core.convert.FromSame
              pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError) residual
        else ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        Unit (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError)
        residual

/-- [aspis_statement::pool_v1::incremental_merkle::tree_reference::{aspis_statement::pool_v1::incremental_merkle::tree_reference::OwnedTree}::from_parts]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-statement/src/pool_v1/../../../../tools/r1-builder-reference/tree.rs', lines 10:4-16:5
    Visibility: public -/
def pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.from_parts
  (next_leaf_index : Std.U64) (root : Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize)
  (frontier : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 20#usize)
  (empty : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 21#usize) :
  Result (core.result.Result
    pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree
    pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError)
  := do
  let r ←
    pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.validate_owned
      { next_leaf_index, root, frontier } empty
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok
      { inner := { next_leaf_index, root, frontier }, empty })
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree
      (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError)
      residual

/-- [aspis_statement::pool_v1::root_history::root_history_location]:

def pool_v1.root_history.root_history_location
  (sequence : Std.U64) :
  Result pool_v1.root_history.RootHistoryLocationV1
  := do
  let i ← pool_v1.root_history.POOL_V1_ROOT_HISTORY_CAPACITY
  let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 i)
  let i2 ← sequence / i1
  let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 i)
  let i4 ← sequence % i3
  let i5 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U16 i4)
  ok { page_number := i2, slot := i5 }

/-- [aspis_statement::pool_v1::incremental_merkle::tree_reference::{aspis_statement::pool_v1::incremental_merkle::tree_reference::OwnedTree}::append_one]: loop 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-statement/src/pool_v1/../../../../tools/r1-builder-reference/tree.rs', lines 27:8-31:9
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop]
def pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.append_one_loop
  (leaf_index : Std.U64)
  (a : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 21#usize)
  (frontier : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 20#usize)
  (carry : Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) (carry_level : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 20#usize) × (Array
    aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) × Std.Usize)
  := do
  if carry_level < pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH
  then
    let i ← lift (R1Z.BuilderStdModels.shift64 leaf_index carry_level)
    let i1 ← lift (i &&& 1#u64)
    if i1 = 1#u64
    then
      let a1 ← Array.index_usize frontier carry_level
      let carry1 ← pool_v1.format.pool_v1_tree_parent a1 carry
      let a2 ← Array.index_usize a carry_level
      let a3 ← Array.update frontier carry_level a2
      let carry_level1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add carry_level 1#usize)
      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.append_one_loop
        leaf_index a a3 carry1 carry_level1
    else ok (frontier, carry, carry_level)
  else ok (frontier, carry, carry_level)
partial_fixpoint

/-- [aspis_statement::pool_v1::incremental_merkle::tree_reference::{aspis_statement::pool_v1::incremental_merkle::tree_reference::OwnedTree}::append_one]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-statement/src/pool_v1/../../../../tools/r1-builder-reference/tree.rs', lines 19:4-64:5
    Visibility: public -/
def pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.append_one
  (self : pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree)
  (leaf : Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) :
  Result (core.result.Result
    (pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree ×
    pool_v1.incremental_merkle.AppendOneV1)
    pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError)
  := do
  let i ← pool_v1.incremental_merkle.POOL_V1_LEAF_CAPACITY
  if self.inner.next_leaf_index = i
  then
    ok (core.result.Result.Err
      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError.TreeFull)
  else
    let (frontier, root, carry_level) ←
      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.append_one_loop
        self.inner.next_leaf_index self.empty self.inner.frontier leaf 0#usize
    let next_leaf_index ←
      lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add self.inner.next_leaf_index 1#u64)
    if carry_level = pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH
    then
      let rhlv ← pool_v1.root_history.root_history_location next_leaf_index
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok
        ({ self with inner := { next_leaf_index, root, frontier } },
        {
          leaf_index := self.inner.next_leaf_index,
          root_sequence := next_leaf_index,
          root,
          history := rhlv
        }))
    else
      let frontier1 ← Array.update frontier carry_level root
      let a := Array.repeat 8#usize aspis_core.field.M31.ZERO
      let r ←
        pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.reconstruct_nonfull_root_from_level
          { next_leaf_index, root := a, frontier := frontier1 } self.empty
          carry_level
      let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
      match cf with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
        let rhlv ← pool_v1.root_history.root_history_location next_leaf_index
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok
          ({
             self
               with
               inner := { next_leaf_index, root := val, frontier := frontier1 }
           },
          {
            leaf_index := self.inner.next_leaf_index,
            root_sequence := next_leaf_index,
            root := val,
            history := rhlv
          }))
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          (pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree ×
          pool_v1.incremental_merkle.AppendOneV1) (core.convert.FromSame
          pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError) residual

def
  pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.from_parts_with_empty_roots
  (next_leaf_index : Std.U64) (root : Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize)
  (frontier : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 20#usize)
  (empty : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 21#usize) :
  Result (core.result.Result pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1
    pool_v1.incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError)

    pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.from_parts
      next_leaf_index root frontier empty

  | core.result.Result.Ok value =>
    let imtv ←
      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.into_inner value
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok imtv)
  | core.result.Result.Err error => ok (core.result.Result.Err error)

def pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.rust_writer_chain
  (w : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RW)
  (p : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RP) (h : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U32 256#usize)
  := do
  let b ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.node_kind h
  if b
  then
    let (l, r) ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.children w p h
    let pre ← aspis_r0_block_writer_copies.node_pre r
    let ab ← aspis_r0_block_writer_copies.node_absorb l
    let a ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.perm pre ab
    aspis_r0_block_writer_copies.write_block pre ab a
  else
    let b1 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.zero_kind p h
    if b1
    then
      let z := Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32
      let a ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.perm z z
      aspis_r0_block_writer_copies.write_block z z a
    else
      let pre ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.sponge_pre w p h
      let a ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.schunk w p h
      let i ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.sclen h
      let ab ← aspis_r0_block_writer_copies.sponge_absorb a i
      let a1 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.perm pre ab
      aspis_r0_block_writer_copies.write_block pre ab a1

  (w : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RW)

  Result ((Array (Array Std.U32 8#usize) 24#usize) × (Array (Array Std.U32

  (pt : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.Parts) (c : Std.Usize) (r : Std.Usize)
  :
  Result Std.U32
  := do

  then

    then

      let a ←
        alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array
          Std.U32 256#usize)) pt.blocks i
      let i1 ← r % 16#usize
      let i2 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul i1 16#usize)
      let i3 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i2 c)
      Array.index_usize a i3
    else
      if r < pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.AUX_ROW0
      then
        let i ←
          lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub r
            pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.PATH_ROW0)
        let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul i 16#usize)
        let i2 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i1 c)

        let i ←
          lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub r
            pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.AUX_ROW0)
        let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul i 16#usize)
        let i2 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i1 c)
        Array.index_usize pt.aux i2
  else ok 0#u32

  (state : Array aspis_core.field.M31 16#usize) (round : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Option Unit) × (Array aspis_core.field.M31 16#usize))
  := do
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice poseidon2.EXTERNAL_INITIAL)
  let i := Slice.len s
  if round < i
  then
    let constants1 ← Array.index_usize poseidon2.EXTERNAL_INITIAL round
    let state1 ←
      poseidon2.apply_round_by_index_loop0
        { start := 0#usize, «end» := poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH } state
        constants1
    let state2 ← poseidon2.external_linear_lazy state1
    ok (some (), state2)
  else
    let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice poseidon2.EXTERNAL_INITIAL)
    let i1 := Slice.len s1
    let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice poseidon2.INTERNAL)
    let i2 := Slice.len s2
    let i3 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i1 i2)
    if round < i3
    then
      let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice poseidon2.EXTERNAL_INITIAL)
      let i4 := Slice.len s3
      let i5 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub round i4)
      let constant1 ← Array.index_usize poseidon2.INTERNAL i5
      let m ← Array.index_usize state 0#usize
      let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.add m constant1
      let m2 ← poseidon2.pow5 m1
      let state1 ← Array.update state 0#usize m2
      let state2 ← poseidon2.internal_linear_lazy state1
      ok (some (), state2)
    else
      if round < poseidon2.POSEIDON2_ROUNDS
      then
        let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice poseidon2.EXTERNAL_INITIAL)
        let i4 := Slice.len s3
        let i5 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub round i4)
        let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice poseidon2.INTERNAL)
        let i6 := Slice.len s4
        let i7 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub i5 i6)
        let constants1 ← Array.index_usize poseidon2.EXTERNAL_FINAL i7
        let state1 ←
          poseidon2.apply_round_by_index_loop1
            { start := 0#usize, «end» := poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH } state
            constants1
        let state2 ← poseidon2.external_linear_lazy state1
        ok (some (), state2)
      else ok (none, state)

/-- [aspis_statement::poseidon2::evaluate_trace_round_pair]:

def poseidon2.evaluate_trace_round_pair
  (state : Array aspis_core.field.M31 16#usize) (local_row : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Option ((Array aspis_core.field.M31 16#usize) × (Array
    aspis_core.field.M31 16#usize)))
  := do
  let i ← poseidon2.POSEIDON2_ROUNDS / 2#usize
  if local_row >= i
  then ok none
  else
    let state1 ←
      if local_row = 0#usize
      then poseidon2.external_linear_lazy state
      else ok state
    let first_round ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize local_row)
    let (o, state2) ← poseidon2.apply_round_by_index state1 first_round
    let cf ← core.option.Option.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitTry.branch o
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
      let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add first_round 1#usize)
      let (o1, state3) ← poseidon2.apply_round_by_index state2 i1
      let cf1 ← core.option.Option.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitTry.branch o1
      match cf1 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
        ok (some (state2, state3))
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        core.option.Option.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualOptionInfallible.from_residual
          ((Array aspis_core.field.M31 16#usize) × (Array aspis_core.field.M31
          16#usize)) residual
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.option.Option.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualOptionInfallible.from_residual
        ((Array aspis_core.field.M31 16#usize) × (Array aspis_core.field.M31
        16#usize)) residual

      pool_v1.pair_trace.PoolV1PairTraceErrorV1.SnapshotBindingMismatch)

      pool_v1.incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.from_parts_with_empty_roots

      pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical self.second_commitment

    then

      then

          pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLeafErrorV1.NonCanonicalOccupancy)

                self

              aspis_core.field.M31.mul m2 self.second_occupancy_inverse
            let b3 ←
              core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default
